root.code:
' ===== Tetris =====
' The board is ONE string: 10 columns x 20 rows, one character per cell.
' "." = empty, "1".."7" = a locked block (the digit selects its colour).
' Controls on the form: Canvas1 (200 x 400), lblScore, lblHelp, cmdNew, cmdLeft, cmdRight, cmdRotate, cmdDown, cmdDrop

Const W = 10
Const H = 20
Const CELL = 20

Dim board As String
Dim shp As String      ' current piece as a size x size grid of "X" and "."
Dim n As Integer       ' size of that grid
Dim px As Integer      ' column / row of the grid's top-left corner on the board
Dim py As Integer
Dim pk As Integer      ' colour number of the current piece (1..7)
Dim score As Integer
Dim lines As Integer
Dim playing As Boolean
Dim over As Boolean

Sub Form_Load()
    board = Replace(Space(W * H), " ", ".")
    Draw
End Sub

' ---------- buttons ----------
Sub cmdNew_Click()
    board = Replace(Space(W * H), " ", ".")
    score = 0
    lines = 0
    over = False
    playing = True
    NewPiece
    StartTimer Speed()
    Draw
End Sub

Sub cmdLeft_Click()
    MoveBy(-1)
End Sub

Sub cmdRight_Click()
    MoveBy(1)
End Sub

Sub cmdRotate_Click()
    Dim t As String
    If Not playing Then Exit Sub
    t = Rotated(shp, n)
    If Not Hits(t, n, px, py) Then
        shp = t
    ElseIf Not Hits(t, n, px - 1, py) Then
        shp = t
        px = px - 1
    ElseIf Not Hits(t, n, px + 1, py) Then
        shp = t
        px = px + 1
    ElseIf Not Hits(t, n, px - 2, py) Then
        shp = t
        px = px - 2
    ElseIf Not Hits(t, n, px + 2, py) Then
        shp = t
        px = px + 2
    End If
    Draw
End Sub

Sub cmdDown_Click()
    If playing Then Tick
End Sub

Sub cmdDrop_Click()
    If Not playing Then Exit Sub
    Do While Not Hits(shp, n, px, py + 1)
        py = py + 1
    Loop
    Tick
End Sub

' ---------- keyboard: arrows move / rotate / step, Space drops, Enter starts ----------
Sub Form_KeyDown(KeyCode As Integer)
    Select Case KeyCode
        Case vbKeyLeft
            MoveBy(-1)
        Case vbKeyRight
            MoveBy(1)
        Case vbKeyUp
            cmdRotate_Click
        Case vbKeyDown
            cmdDown_Click
        Case vbKeySpace
            cmdDrop_Click
        Case vbKeyReturn
            If Not playing Then cmdNew_Click
    End Select
End Sub

' ---------- game logic ----------
Sub Form_Timer()
    If playing Then Tick
End Sub

' One step down: move the piece, or lock it, clear full rows and start the next piece.
Sub Tick()
    If Hits(shp, n, px, py + 1) Then
        LockPiece
        ClearLines
        NewPiece
    Else
        py = py + 1
    End If
    Draw
End Sub

Sub MoveBy(dx As Integer)
    If Not playing Then Exit Sub
    If Not Hits(shp, n, px + dx, py) Then px = px + dx
    Draw
End Sub

Sub NewPiece()
    pk = Int(Rnd * 7) + 1
    shp = PieceShape(pk)
    n = Int(Sqr(Len(shp)))
    px = Int((W - n) / 2)
    py = 0
    If Hits(shp, n, px, py) Then GameOver
End Sub

Sub GameOver()
    playing = False
    over = True
    StopTimer
End Sub

Sub LockPiece()
    Dim r, c, i
    For r = 0 To n - 1
        For c = 0 To n - 1
            If Mid(shp, r * n + c + 1, 1) = "X" Then
                i = (py + r) * W + px + c
                board = Left(board, i) & pk & Mid(board, i + 2)
            End If
        Next c
    Next r
End Sub

Sub ClearLines()
    Dim y As Integer
    Dim cnt As Integer
    cnt = 0
    y = H - 1
    Do While y >= 0
        If InStr(Mid(board, y * W + 1, W), ".") = 0 Then
            ' remove row y, add an empty row on top (and look at the same y again)
            board = Replace(Space(W), " ", ".") & Left(board, y * W) & Mid(board, y * W + W + 1)
            cnt = cnt + 1
        Else
            y = y - 1
        End If
    Loop
    If cnt > 0 Then
        score = score + 100 * cnt * cnt
        lines = lines + cnt
        StartTimer Speed()
    End If
End Sub

' Interval of the timer in ms: faster every 5 lines.
Function Speed() As Integer
    Dim s As Integer
    s = 500 - 40 * Int(lines / 5)
    If s < 100 Then s = 100
    Return s
End Function

' Would the grid s (size x size) collide with a wall, the floor or a locked block when placed at column cx, row cy?
Function Hits(s As String, size As Integer, cx As Integer, cy As Integer) As Boolean
    Dim r, c, bx, by
    For r = 0 To size - 1
        For c = 0 To size - 1
            If Mid(s, r * size + c + 1, 1) = "X" Then
                bx = cx + c
                by = cy + r
                If bx < 0 Or bx >= W Or by >= H Then Return True
                If by >= 0 Then
                    If Mid(board, by * W + bx + 1, 1) <> "." Then Return True
                End If
            End If
        Next c
    Next r
    Return False
End Function

' The grid turned 90 degrees clockwise.
Function Rotated(s As String, size As Integer) As String
    Dim r, c, t
    t = ""
    For r = 0 To size - 1
        For c = 0 To size - 1
            t = t & Mid(s, (size - 1 - c) * size + r + 1, 1)
        Next c
    Next r
    Return t
End Function

' The seven pieces (I, O, T, S, Z, J, L), row by row.
Function PieceShape(k As Integer) As String
    If k = 1 Then Return "....XXXX........"
    If k = 2 Then Return "XXXX"
    If k = 3 Then Return ".X.XXX..."
    If k = 4 Then Return ".XXXX...."
    If k = 5 Then Return "XX..XX..."
    If k = 6 Then Return "X..XXX..."
    Return "..XXXX..."
End Function

' ---------- drawing: the whole picture is repainted in one go, so nothing flickers ----------
Sub DrawCell(cx As Integer, cy As Integer, k As Integer)
    Canvas1.DrawColor = Mid("#00d8d8#e8d800#a040e0#40c840#e03030#3060f0#f09020", (k - 1) * 7 + 1, 7)
    Canvas1.FillRect cx * CELL + 1, cy * CELL + 1, CELL - 2, CELL - 2
End Sub

Sub Draw()
    Dim x, y, r, c, ch
    Canvas1.Clear
    Canvas1.DrawColor = "#14181f"
    Canvas1.FillRect 0, 0, W * CELL, H * CELL
    For y = 0 To H - 1
        For x = 0 To W - 1
            ch = Mid(board, y * W + x + 1, 1)
            If ch <> "." Then DrawCell x, y, Val(ch)
        Next x
    Next y
    If playing Then
        For r = 0 To n - 1
            For c = 0 To n - 1
                If Mid(shp, r * n + c + 1, 1) = "X" Then DrawCell px + c, py + r, pk
            Next c
        Next r
    End If
    If over Then
        Canvas1.DrawColor = "#000000"
        Canvas1.FillRect 40, 170, 120, 40
        Canvas1.DrawColor = "#ffffff"
        Canvas1.DrawRect 40, 170, 120, 40
        Canvas1.DrawText "GAME OVER", 62, 183
    End If
    lblScore.Caption = "Score: " & score & "   Lines: " & lines
End Sub

Keys:
Left / Right  move
Up  rotate
Down  step down
Space  drop
Enter  new game
